gloss: to wobble; to shake; to be unsteady

definitions.gloss: to wobble; to shake; to be unsteady
definitions.explanation: Describes something that is physically unstable and shaking or rocking back and forth. Used for loose teeth, shaky furniture, buildings during earthquakes, or boiling liquid.
Figuratively describes a person whose resolve, opinions, or decisions are unsteady and keep changing.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{椅子|いす}→椅子：00706_isu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ぐらぐらして⟦{危|あぶ}ない→危ない：00768_abunai⟧。
examples.english: This chair wobbles and is dangerous.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ぐらぐら→ぐらぐら：16211_guragura⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}れた→揺れる：01161_yureru⟧。
examples.english: The building shook and swayed during the earthquake.

examples.japanese: {気持|きも}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぐらぐらする。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{説得|せっとく}→説得：14219_settoku⟧⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{決意|けつい}→決意：07167_ketsui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぐらぐらした。
examples.english: His persuasion made my resolve waver.

examples.japanese: ぐらぐらしないで、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貫|つらぬ}き→貫く：18728_tsuranuku⟧⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧。
examples.english: Don't waver — stick to your own opinion.

notes:
Mimetic verb where the reduplication ⟦ぐらぐら→ぐらぐら：16211_guragura⟧ evokes repeated, unstable rocking or swaying motion. One of the most common onomatopoeia for physical instability. Also used for water at a rolling boil (お湯⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ぐらぐら→ぐらぐら：16211_guragura⟧沸く).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{歯|は}→歯：00778_ha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぐらぐらする: tooth is loose
- ⟦ぐらぐら→ぐらぐら：16211_guragura⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}れる→揺れる：01161_yureru⟧: to shake/sway
- ⟦お{湯|ゆ}→お湯：02518_oyu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ぐらぐら→ぐらぐら：16211_guragura⟧⟦{沸|わ}く→沸く：01122_waku⟧: water boils vigorously
- {気持|きも}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぐらぐらする: to feel indecisive
- ⟦ぐらぐら→ぐらぐら：16211_guragura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{机|つくえ}→机：00762_tsukue⟧: a wobbly desk

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦がたがた→がたがた：05274_gatagata⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to rattle, to be rickety — implies loose parts rattling, more mechanical
- ⟦ゆらゆら→ゆらゆら：04817_yurayura⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to sway gently — slower, calmer motion; not necessarily unstable
- ⟦ふらふらする→ふらふらする：21629_furafurasuru⟧: to be unsteady (person) — describes a person who is dizzy or staggering
